meta.unit: tokens per glyph, marginal, inside a run of `repeats` copies
meta.probe_note: ASCII tokenizer probes measured as a control for the glyph blocks. Not words, not transliterations of words; the language has no Latin form.
meta.stripped_note: cost 0 = removed from the input before tokenization; the model never sees the glyph. Unusable, not cheap.
